key_finding: Pairwise affine Needleman-Wunsch of E. coli NrdB onto Rnr2 (28.4% id) and Rnr4 (21.8% id), and Rnr2 onto Rnr4 (55.1% id over 345 columns): NrdB D85/E116/H119/E205/E239/H242 map to Rnr2 D145/E176/H179/E239/E273/H276 (6/6) and to Rnr4 D93/E124/Y127/E186/R220/Y223 (3/6). Human RRM2 and RRM2B keep 6/6.
context: sequence analysis, UniProt P69924, P09938, P49723, P31350, Q7LG56
confidence_and_limitations: High. Rnr2-Rnr4 identity of 55% makes the alignment unambiguous; the Rnr2 mapping independently reproduces UniProt's own Fe-ligand annotation, which is the positive control.

claim_tested: The Rnr4 metal pocket cannot bind iron
key_finding: PDB 1JK0: the single Zn sits in chain A (Rnr2) at E176 OE1 2.03 A, E239 OE1 2.04 A, H276 ND1 2.13 A, E273 OE1 2.31 A. Superposing Rnr2 onto Rnr4 (242 CA pairs, core RMSD 1.12 A) places the metal position 2.13 A from Rnr4 Tyr223 CD1, with Gln120 and Arg220 completing a substitute network. Ligand-equivalent CA positions deviate 0.10-0.91 A.
context: X-ray 2.8 A, S. cerevisiae Rnr2-Rnr4 heterodimer
confidence_and_limitations: High for the ligand identities. The occlusion distance depends on a modelled side-chain rotamer at 2.8 A, so read it as "the cavity is filled", not as an exact clash distance.

key_finding: "Y4 lacks three conserved iron-binding residues"; "A single metal ion, assigned as Zn(II), occupies the Fe2 position in the Y2 active site"; "No metal-binding site is observed in Y4."
confidence_and_limitations: High. Primary structure paper; independently matches every number computed here.

claim_tested: Rnr4 lacks three iron ligands; Rnr4 orders Rnr2 helix alphaB
key_finding: "Rnr4 is unique in that it lacks three iron-binding residues conserved in all other R2s"; "In the Rnr2 homodimer, one of the iron-binding helices, helix alphaB, is not well-ordered"; "In the heterodimer, interactions with a loop region connecting Rnr4 helices alphaA and alpha3 stabilize this Rnr2 helix, which donates iron ligand Asp 145."
context: X-ray 3.1 A, Rnr2 and Rnr4 homodimers, PDB 1SMQ and 1SMS
confidence_and_limitations: High for the ligand count. The helix-ordering claim rests on unmodelled density, which indicates mobility rather than a defined conformation.

claim_tested: Rnr4 is only a passive scaffold
key_finding: 1JK0 chain A (Rnr2 with Rnr4) is continuous 26-359 and models all 13 residues of helix alphaB including Asp145. All four chains of the Rnr2 homodimer 1SMQ break at residues 145-149 and leave Asp145 unmodelled. 1SMS (Rnr4 homodimer) shows the full substitute pocket D93, E124, Y127, E186, R220, Y223, Q120 plus Tyr131, with only surface Hg and no iron.
context: X-ray 2.8 and 3.1 A, three crystal forms
confidence_and_limitations: Medium-high. Independent reproduction of PMID:15196016 from coordinates. Different space groups and resolutions, so the disorder comparison is qualitative.

claim_tested: Is the Rnr4 iron-site loss general or lineage-specific?
key_finding: 482 of 493 fungal IPR000358 proteins (467 species) keep the DEHEEH ligand set; only S. cerevisiae RNR4, S. pastorianus, S. eubayanus and S. kudriavzevii carry the full DEYERY pattern. Six post-WGD genomes each have one intact 391-403 aa paralog (75.0-86.0% id to Rnr2) and one short 335-352 aa paralog (41.1-53.7% id) keeping only 1-3 ligands. Seven of seven paralogs in pre-WGD and outgroup genomes are intact.
confidence_and_limitations: Medium-high. The 493-sequence set is page 1 of the UniProt result and is not a taxonomically balanced sample; the per-genome panel of 12 species was selected deliberately and is the stronger evidence.

stance: refutes a clause of the seed hypothesis
key_finding: Rnr4 Tyr131 aligns to NrdB Tyr123, Rnr2 Tyr183, RRM2 Tyr176 and RRM2B Tyr138, and after superposition its hydroxyl oxygen lands 0.71 A from that of Rnr2 Tyr183. All 493 fungal R2 proteins scanned carry Tyr at this position. UniProt independently annotates P49723 Tyr131 as an active site.
confidence_and_limitations: High. The Kazachstania africana degenerate paralog H2ATX3 has His here, showing the position is under relaxed constraint in this clade even though S. cerevisiae keeps Tyr.

claim_tested: Rnr4 is catalytically inactive but drives cofactor assembly
key_finding: "Y2, Y3, and Y4 isolated from E. coli have no measurable activity"; "Efforts to generate Y. in Y2 or Y4 using Fe(2+), O(2), and reductant have been unsuccessful"; adding Y4 with Fe(2+) and O2 to inactive Y2 gives 0.069 micromol/min/mg (0.30 for His6-Y2-K387N); "Y4 appears to play an important role in diiron-Y. assembly of Y2."
context: purified yeast and E. coli-expressed subunits
confidence_and_limitations: High for the negative activity result. Reconstitution rates are low, so the in-trans assembly result is directional rather than quantitative.

claim_tested: The activity belongs to the heterodimer
key_finding: "Holo Y2Y4 heterodimer contains 0.6-0.8 Y* and has a specific activity of 0.8-1.3 micromol.min.mg"; "Titration of Y2 with Y4 in the presence of Fe(2+) and O(2) gives maximal activity with one equivalent of Y4 per Y2."
context: purified yeast RNR subunits, in vitro
confidence_and_limitations: High. In vitro reconstitution; 1:1 stoichiometry is the basis for contributes_to.

claim_tested: Is Rnr4 strictly required for RNR chemistry?
key_finding: "The Y* content of rnr4delta is 15-fold less than that of wt, consistent with the observed low activity of rnr4delta extracts"; several rnr4delta strains are viable; genomically tagged beta or beta' isolates a 1:1 complex; FLAG-beta2 from rnr4delta retains 2 nmol/min/mg.
confidence_and_limitations: High. Shows the Rnr4 contribution is quantitative, roughly 15-fold on radical content, not absolute.

claim_tested: Rnr4 acts in iron loading in vivo
key_finding: "rnr4 mutants are defective in iron loading into nascent beta and are hypersensitive to iron depletion and the Tyr(.)-reducing agent hydroxyurea"; "Although only beta is capable of iron binding and Tyr(.) formation, cells lacking beta' are either dead or exhibit extremely low Tyr(.) levels and RNR activity depending on genetic backgrounds"; Tyr radical forms in permeabilised rnr4delta spheroplasts on adding recombinant beta', blocked by chelator added before but not after.
context: S. cerevisiae in vivo and permeabilised spheroplasts
confidence_and_limitations: High. Places Rnr4 in an iron delivery pathway with Grx3/Grx4 and Dre2; the pathway assignment is partly genetic.

claim_tested: Rnr4 is part of the trafficking unit
key_finding: "Rnr2 generates a diferric-tyrosyl radical cofactor required for catalysis; Rnr4 facilitates cofactor assembly and stabilizes the resulting holo-heterodimer"; tagging either subunit with an NES relocalises both.
confidence_and_limitations: High for co-transport. The division-of-labour sentence is the authors' framing of prior work.

claim_tested: Nuclear anchoring of the Rnr2-Rnr4 complex
key_finding: Wtm1 binds Rnr2/4 complexes and anchors them in the nucleus outside S phase; wtm1 deletion gives cytoplasmic Rnr2/Rnr4.
confidence_and_limitations: High. Concerns the complex, and does not separate the two subunits.

claim_tested: Does RNR4 essentiality imply catalytic activity?
key_finding: RNR4 is essential; "The lethality of RNR4 deletion mutations can be suppressed by overexpression of RNR1 and RNR3"; Rnr2 and Rnr4 coimmunoprecipitate.
confidence_and_limitations: High as genetics. Cannot assign catalytic activity to a subunit, yet it underlies two enables-qualified GO:0004748 lines.

key_finding: GO:0004748 appears nine times on P49723, five as enables and four as contributes_to; GO:0016491 is enables, IEA from InterPro IPR012348 (ferritin-like di-iron domain).
confidence_and_limitations: High as a record of current state. Reaction and fold mappings cannot see that the di-iron site is destroyed.
